title: GPU schema EnumOf fields cannot declare a default
body: FrameTargets.cs needed a closed PresentationMode enum with canonical default, but EnumOf<T>.Default(...) is rejected by the current kernel parser; the landed workaround uses UInt backing plus a separate enum. Make enum vocabulary and numeric defaults composable.

title: Codegen drift target does not merge generated SDI headers
body: frame_targets_refresh regenerated the ExposureTonemapSystem shader/header after its signature changed, but runtime used stale ExposureTonemapSystem-SDI.g.h until manually running build/wsl/bin/sdi_tool merge-variants VIXEN/shaders/sdi-variants.json. Make the codegen target include the SDI merge.

title: Tone-map reference test flag treats zero as enabled
body: VIXEN_EXPOSURE_TONEMAP_REFERENCE=0 still selected ExposureTonemapReference because envFlagEnabled is presence-based; the parity harness had to be changed to omit the variable for system cases. Align CTest environment generation with the runtime flag contract or parse explicit 0/1.

title: VIXEN CMake regeneration requires an implicit UNDERTOW_ROOT
body: The queued cmake --build build/wsl target vixen_lookdev_capture failed during automatic reconfigure at libraries/Text/CMakeLists.txt:5 because UNDERTOW_ROOT was absent; rerunning with env UNDERTOW_ROOT=/home/liory/projects/undertow/.claude-worktrees/pair-aadither cmake --build ... recovered. Make the paired Undertow root part of the configured build state or report a stable setup failure.

title: VIXEN final build checks stale FrameTargets schema before refreshing it
body: bash ./build-wsl.sh -j4 reached frame_targets_schema_check and failed on frame-targets.schemas.json drift; the queued cmake --build build/wsl --target frame_targets_refresh -j2 regeneration was required before the same final build passed. Make the final build depend on the refresh or make source staging and the check consume one generated snapshot.
